references.text: Caleb silenced the people and encouraged them to go up and take possession of the land, showing a contrast to the spies' advice at Ai where they underestimated the enemy.
The Israelites refused to go up into the promised land because of fear, while here at Ai they showed overconfidence and underestimated the enemy.
Moses encouraged the people to go up without fear, which contrasts with the spies' overconfident advice that only a few men were needed.
At Jericho, Israel followed the Lord's exact instructions, while at Ai they relied on their own judgment without seeking the Lord's guidance.
The result of following the spies' advice was defeat at Ai, where about 36 men fell and the people lost heart.
Proverbs warns against relying on one's own wisdom, which is what the spies did when they underestimated Ai.
A warning against trusting in human strength instead of the Lord, relevant to Israel's self-confidence at Ai.
